checks: conditional records require the current active M10 and M11 and their exact current AdvisorOutput and TeacherOutput versions
B1/B2 outputs must share the dossier, current W16 revision, theme and specification
the original B1 core judgment and supported scope must be preserved exactly; C cannot rewrite them as a later prediction
the B2 proposition and proposition scope must also be preserved exactly
conditional Claim, Evidence and W25 assessment bases must equal the exact union of current B1/B2 bases; MethodUse must be current in the dossier
MULTI_PATH requires at least two paths with distinct branch conditions and distinct first distinguishing observations
SINGLE_LIMITED requires exactly one bounded path; NOT_APPLICABLE permits no invented path and requires an explicit reason and limitations
each path has at least two ordered actor/system steps covering authority or resources, decision/transmission, preconditions, resulting state, minimum lag and uncertainty
each path records beneficiaries, cost bearers, feedback, failure/exit conditions and an explicit statement that its future is conditional rather than current fact
path Claim/Evidence/MethodUse references must equal the declared basis rather than using unrecorded material
every mode records missing information, why paths cannot yet be distinguished and next discriminating observations
the review window is timezone-aware, ordered and carries a rationale
supporting, weakening and overturning observations are mandatory, together with mechanism and alternative-explanation checks
open questions are stored for reader thought only; the output fixes reader_answers_collected=false
future review routes only to W39 or W40; W33 is marked as the later ThesisVersion storage target rather than falsely claiming it already occurred
MULTI_PATH closes as READY_FOR_NEXT; single/not-applicable close as LIMITED
M12 records supported scope, remaining unknowns, stop reason, reopening trigger and an allowed research owner at the current knowledge cutoff
the output fixes role=C, forecast_is_fact=false, observed_outcome_claimed=false, content_review_required=true and publication_authorized=false
no probability, observed result, final stock price or necessary-win field is accepted
manual output cannot carry model execution identity
model output requires a current W19 EXPLANATION/given-material admission and an actual M12 MODEL OperationRequest containing every conditional input
the operation requires MODEL_PROCESS and a successful receipt before the C output; output references the operation
exact retries are idempotent; interrupted M12 output remains unadopted and exact retry on unchanged basis resumes
concurrent exact writers leave one active M12; upstream rework uses prior M12 history and new B1/B2/C parent versions
